annotations.title: Generate all declared images in a deck

description: Fill in every AI-declared image in a deck at once. In the deck language, `image gen {prompt="misty harbor at dawn" x=… y=… w=… h=…}` places an image that renders as a placeholder until generated; this tool generates each one (honoring the theme's imageStyle) and wires the assets in. Run it after create_deck/apply_deck when the document declared `image gen` elements. Requires the server to have an image model key configured.
name: generate_deck_images
title: Generate all declared images in a deck
